title: search_players returns overall rating but not detailed skill attributes
evidence: src/bs_tools.erl:338 format_players emits only Overall, Position, Club, age, nationality; the player() record (src/bs_data.erl:22) does not retain the per-skill columns (Crossing, Finishing, Dribbling, ...) the spec lists under FIFA data
suggestion: R8's 'ratings/attributes' is satisfied by the overall rating; surfacing a few key skill attributes would more fully match the spec's player example

title: aggregate_stats top_scorers aggregates goals by team, not by player
evidence: src/bs_query.erl:166 top_scorers sums goals_for per team key; there are no per-player goal data in the match CSVs
suggestion: Spec marks top scorers as '(if inferable from data)'; team-level goal totals are a reasonable substitute. Consider renaming the metric to reflect it is team-level
